summary: P1.10 'Activate Real Telemetry Ingestion' verified end-to-end. Ran regression suites (10 CEF/LEEF DSM + 20 cross-tenant + 12 collectors + 97 pipeline/engine = 139 pass), ran live UDP proof driver (4 real CEF/LEEF events over 127.0.0.1:5514), and confirmed the full honest-state chain: collector service delivered +4 (13→17) with zero NEW dead_letters, core collector col_6551885c766a458ab315 CONNECTED with recv/parsed/norm counters advancing by 4, 4 v2_shadow_observations with origin='collector-live' created, exactly 2 promoted to real incidents on /api/incidents (customer=nivx-live, detection_source=nivxray::xdr::veee, titles with real dest IPs 203.0.113.55 & 198.51.100.7), 2 correctly refused with case_id=null. Ingest contract: bare list AND {'envelopes':[...]} both return 200; tenant isolation guard fires 403 TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION BEFORE collector lookup (header-vs-envelope mismatch AND mixed envelope tenants); mixed collectors returns 400 MIXED_COLLECTORS. Protocol catalog reports cef/leef IMPLEMENTED, counts implemented=5 total=12. Honest UNKNOWN state confirmed: CEF has process.ppid=null with epistemic_state.ppid=UNKNOWN and file_sha256=UNKNOWN; LEEF has pid=null with epistemic_state.pid=UNKNOWN. CEF/LEEF parsing correct: raw_ref.line preserved verbatim; unescaped base64 in cs1= was NOT read as a new key (parse_notes records 'not_a_key:SQBFAFgAJwBoAHQAdABwAA') and full command line survives intact; LEEF 2.0 spaces in cmd= survive. Severity band: CEF sev=8→HIGH, LEEF sev=9→CRITICAL (Suricata numeric path unchanged in regression). No fabricated PIDs/hashes/incidents; two refusals reported honestly.

minor.issue: Top-level convenience flags pid_state/ppid_state/file_sha256_state on canonical evidence documents are stored inside additional_fields.epistemic_state map rather than as sibling top-level fields — the epistemic marking is present and honest, but the review contract's literal top-level field-name expectation is met only via the map. Not a correctness bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Live reasoning bridge is a DSM (detection_content/telemetry/cef_leef_dsm.py) — no parallel/second reasoning engine was introduced; the canonical process_event_through_pipeline path is the only reasoning chain. Confirmed by code inspection and by observing incidents materialising from the standard verdict card + xdr_pipeline stages on workspace_cases docs.

Tenant-isolation guard correctly fires BEFORE collector lookup — verified programmatically: mismatched envelope tenant returns 403 TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION rather than 404 collector-not-found (would leak collector existence).

Honest-state rule holds under adversarial probe: two of four real events did NOT warrant an incident and were correctly recorded as observations with case_id=null. No synthetic PID/PPID/hash/case fabricated.
